description: RTK build/linter command detection currently uses unanchored substring matching. An SSH command referencing github.com/nats-io/natscli is misclassified as `tsc`, and its output is replaced with a synthetic build-success summary. Restrict routing to recognized top-level commands (after supported command prefixes/wrappers), preserve SSH/Python output, and add exact regression coverage. Validate lint, tests, and typecheck.
title: Prevent RTK classifiers from consuming wrapped SSH and Python output
